EngagementSignal.name: EngagementSignal
EngagementSignal.description: Represents data about an individual’s engagement action, such as a web click, an email response, or a PDF download. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

DataSpaceId.description: Required. Unique identifier that refers to the data space where the engagement signal originates.

Description.description: An optional text description of the engagement signal.

DeveloperName.description: Required. API name for the engagement signal that's system-or user-generated.

IsRemote.description: Indicates if the engagement signal object is owned by a different org in Data 360.

LastReferencedDate.description: Timestamp that indicates the last time the engagement signal was referenced by the current user.

LastViewedDate.description: Timestamp that indicates the last time the current user viewed the engagement signal record.

Name.description: Required. Text label that identifies the engagement signal.

Status.description: Picklist value that indicates the current status of the engagement signal.
